F · Not here

Site B component — Two-column ledger of what Aynera deliberately leaves out.

Left out

Deliberately missing

What you won't find on Aynera.

  • 01

    No endless feed

    You get a small set of considered introductions and real local gatherings — not a slot machine designed to keep your thumb moving.

  • 02

    No unilateral relationship mode

    A request never becomes a relationship state by itself. Focus and Together need two independent yeses.

  • 03

    No safety behind a paywall

    Reporting, blocking, and date-safety sharing stay free for everyone.

  • 04

    No invented match scores

    We never fake a compatibility percentage. We show why an introduction was made, in plain words.

G · FAQ

Site B component — Accordion-style questions people ask first.

Questions

Questions

The things people ask first.

How is Aynera different from a swipe app?

Introductions are limited and explained, and you can also meet through small Taste gatherings. When two people choose Focus, discovery pauses for both.

What exactly is Taste?

Taste is the way you actually live — what you enjoy, how you spend your time, your social rhythm, food, movement, culture and hobbies.

Do I have to pick dating or matrimony?

No. You say what you would genuinely be happy for a connection to become, and you can change it whenever life changes.

Which cities are open?

Delhi NCR is opening first, with Bangalore and Mumbai as next-city interest.
